question: What concluding ablution rite may be performed at the end of the procedure?
premises: Bathing is to be caused at the end.
inference: At the end, one should have the bathing performed, optionally according to the five-nectar rite.
uncertainties: The scope of vā (alternative to what) is not fully explicit.
plain_english: At the end one should have the bathing performed, or indeed the rite of the five nectars.
